# C8 A 78 f.1 (de Grasse to the Navy minister, Martinique 4 April 1779; duplicate), images FRANOM23_C8A_078_0001 to _0003; cipher only, read 3 Nov 2026. Marginal note on 0001: duplicate whose first copy was deciphered ("Chiffre de 1777"). Stray commas, semicolons and line-end dashes in the original not shown.
# 0001 (P1): clear: dateline "a la Martinique le 4 avril 1779", "Chiffre de 1777", "Monseigneur", page number 1, margin note about the duplicate; cipher = 16 lines in two paragraphs (L1-L11, L12-L16; L16 ends with a comma, text continues on 0002).
# 0002 (P2): no clear text (only a faint show-through of the other side); cipher = 20 lines, paragraph break before P2-L16 (after 400 at the end of L15).
# 0003 (P3): cipher = 5 lines (page number 2 at top); clear closing: "Je suis avec respect, Monseigneur, Votre tres humble et tres obeissant serviteur" (serviteur struck), signed "Le Comte de Grasse".
